guarantees.claim: The data port arrays msg_data_i and keccak_data_o have dimension [Share] where Share = (EnMasking) ? 2 : 1.
msg_strb_i is a flat vector of width MsgStrbW, independent of the Share parameter, providing a single strobe for all shares.

assumptions.claim: start_i and process_i are expected to be single-cycle pulse signals to trigger the padding logic.
assumptions.risk: Level-sensitive assertions may cause unintended repeated triggering or missed operation.

assumptions.claim: msg_strb_i provides a single strobe valid for all shares when msg_valid_i is asserted.
assumptions.risk: If each share requires independent strobe, data validity misalignment can occur.

assumptions.claim: done_i must carry a valid prim_mubi_pkg::mubi4_t encoding.
assumptions.risk: Invalid encoding may cause sparse_fsm_error_o or incorrect state clearing.

assumptions.claim: lc_escalate_en_i reflects the system life cycle state and must be properly driven.
assumptions.risk: Incorrect escalation may violate security or safety requirements.

assumptions.claim: keccak_ready_i handshake must be asserted by the downstream keccak module to accept data.
assumptions.risk: Data transfer stalls or data loss.

assumptions.claim: keccak_complete_i must be asserted after a full keccak_f round has finished.
assumptions.risk: State machine may hang or misinterpret keccak status.

uncertain_points.claim: done_i is mubi4_t but described as a 'pulse signal'; it is unclear whether a MuBi4 encoded transition or a single-bit pulse is expected.
uncertain_points.risk: If misused, module may fail to clear state, causing stuck operation or incorrect digest.

uncertain_points.claim: ns_data_i is only used in cSHAKE mode; in SHA3/SHAKE modes the input may be unused, risking X propagation if not tied to a constant.
error outputs sparse_fsm_error_o and msg_count_error_o are declared but the driving logic is not in this chunk; it is uncertain if they are always driven or can become dead code.
uncertain_points.risk: If never driven, errors go undetected, or synthesis may optimize them away.
